corpusRule: From the already-frozen 16-athlete fixed-query snapshot, retain each unique numeric Flickr original whose credited artist contains Erik Drost and whose upstream URL matches the exact photographer-owned /photos/edrost88/<numeric-id>/ boundary; collapse Commons crops/import duplicates by Flickr ID; sort by Commons DateTimeOriginal date then stable numeric ID. Artist, account path, date, and identity are filters; no Commons or Flickr license field is used.

sample.rule: Before reading any Flickr license: group the enumerated corpus by UTC capture year; assign one slot per represented year; apportion the remaining slots proportional to each year's corpus size by largest remainder with year as stable tie-break; within each year sort by capture date then Flickr ID and select floor((index + 0.5) * available / quota).
